title: fix(plugin-detail): a slotted page's record:chatter on the 动态 tab lists the system history alone while the comment panel holds the comments (#36193)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCeTM2qYEuA9dNQrrsVbmgv)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXV5qLuX94Bn6aqb4y

Fixes #36193

> **Premise.**
> 1. What the card reads now: #36136 (48c732c4) retired the overview's right rail, so the 「最近动态」 card is gone and the overview lists no comment. The card's 「讨论 (3)」 face came from a slotted page whose `discussion` slot holds `record:chatter`; after #36136 that author's block is drawn on the 动态 tab only, where it still drew 「讨论 (4)」, the 全部动态 filter, every comment and reply and a comment box, beside the comment panel showing the same comment (before: `pr36136/timeline-tab-panel-open-*`).
> 2. Reading (seat, 2026-11-21 23:06Z): the card's 「不改动态页签」 means the platform's own 动态 tab (its label and the stream the platform draws). The target is the author-placed chatter/discussion block, which now happens to sit inside that tab.
> 3. `Clause-②: no` (a UI face of an existing block; no contract, permission or spec key).

## What changes

- `renderers/record-chatter.tsx`: while `RecordCommentsInPanelContext` is on and the block is on the default/slotted page (`useDefaultRecordPage()`), a `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` block draws the system entries only: comments and replies filtered out before `applyFeedConfig`, no composer (`onAddComment` withheld, `commentsShown: false`, which also drops the Comments-only filter), a refused or failed comment read not reported (the panel's to say), heading 「动态」 (`detail.timeline`) and empty line `detail.noActivity`. The `(N)` count is the filtered items, so it leaves comments out.
- `RecordChatterPanel.tsx`: optional `titleLabel` / `emptyLabel` props (default 「讨论」 / 「暂无评论」, unchanged for every other caller); a caller-named heading takes the stream's `Activity` icon instead of `MessageSquare` (L1-c nit, 3efc2936).
- Test `renderers/__tests__/record-chatter.commentsInPanel-36193.test.tsx` (6).

Not changed: the platform's own `record:activity` stream, the 动态 tab's label (still 「动态」, no count), an authored (`kind: 'full'`) page.

**Phone, after #36208 (merged into this branch at `abe8f8b5`):** #36208 sets `RecordCommentsInPanelContext` to the panel OR the phone comment page, so on the phone too the author's block on the 动态 tab now drops its comments; the phone's comments live on their own page. Before #36208 the phone had no comment surface and kept them.

### Small calls (seat may overrule)

1. Heading is 「动态」, matching the platform stream's heading in the same tab; the 全部动态 filter stays (its Comments-only entry goes).
2. The switch is "comment panel offered", not "open", as #36114 uses for the stream.

## Why

Card #36193 (epic #36062 phase 1 wrap-up): with the comment panel open the same comment showed twice, and a resolved thread stayed in the record body.

## Verification

- New test 6/6. Ablation (renderer + panel reverted to main): 4 red, the 2 CONTROL cases green.
- plugin-detail chatter / timeline / RecordPageColumns / renderers suites: 123 files, 1,274 tests green. app-shell suites naming `record:chatter` / discussion slots / the comment panel: 14 files, 221 tests green.
- Browser: HotCRM main on `objectstack dev`, console on Vite from this branch, zh-CN, 1440, dpr 2, one comment + one reply on Wayne Enterprises, a local uncommitted slotted `crm_account` page with `slots.discussion: [record:chatter]`. Evidence in the project folder `build-seat1/36193/`:
  - before (main after #36136): `pr36136/timeline-tab-panel-open-{light,dark}.png`: 「讨论 (4)」, the comment and 「1 条回复」 beside the panel.
  - after: `after/timeline-tab-panel-open-{light,dark}.png`: 「动态 (2)」, two system rows, no comment box; `after/overview-panel-open-*`: no comment on the overview; tab row 「… 活动 5 动态」 unchanged.
  - phone: `after/phone-timeline-tab-light.png`: still 「讨论 (4)」 with the comment (no comment surface on the phone yet).
- Drawer: the comment panel is offered in the drawer too (#36114), so the author's block in the drawer's 动态 tab follows the same rule as on the page.
- Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs` clean against main (c30ce97c, after #36208) and open heads.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
